config.label: Bearer aswt_<token> for an active user on your swarm
config.description: Bearer aswt_<token> for an active user on your swarm. Ask a swarm operator to mint it in People > your user > Tokens, or via POST /api/users/{id}/mcp-tokens. Copy the plaintext when minted (shown once). Include the Bearer prefix. The shared swarm API key is not accepted. No endpoint enablement flag is required.
